The save flow is approved. Now the two remaining actions on the same screen.

**Flow 2 — editing an entry afterward.** On any saved entry:
1. Click the **Edit** link (bottom of the entry, next to the "Saved" time).
2. Change the **title or description**, then click **Save changes** — the entry updates in place. (Or **Cancel** to leave it untouched.)

**Flow 3 — the duplicate case.** 
1. Paste a link you've **already saved** into the top box and click **Save.**
2. Instead of a second copy appearing, you should get a short note that you already saved it, and the app should **jump to the existing entry and open it for editing** so you can adjust it.

One decision to confirm on the duplicate case: I chose to treat a link as "already saved" when it's the **same page address** even if it differs by `www.`, a trailing slash, or capitalisation — so, for example, `Example.com/Article/` and `example.com/article` count as the same. Does matching at that level feel right to you, or too loose/too strict?

Try both and tell me how they feel.
